subject: Onboarding & offboarding controls: evidence snapshot and logistics
messages:
From: Elena Park <epark@brightfield-audit.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding & offboarding controls: evidence snapshot and logistics

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. For the SOC 2 / SIG work we are starting next week, could you provide a short evidence snapshot focused on personnel onboarding/offboarding and training for review? To keep this lightweight, the auditor team is asking for the following items by Wednesday 28 Jul: 

- Training completion export (last 12 months) with: employee id (can be hashed), role, training module, completion date, and test score where available. CSV preferred.
- Background check confirmations for new hires since Jan 1, 2025 — vendor name and whether a primary search and identity verification were completed. Redacted PDF confirmations are fine.
- A sample of 6 offboard events (most recent): deprovision timestamp, services deprovisioned (Okta, GSuite, AWS role), and manager approval date.
- Short description of onboarding handoff: who creates accounts, who signs off on access, and typical latency between start date and full access.
- Any role-to-controls mapping you maintain (even a simple CSV) that ties standardized roles to access bundles.

I've attached a template (requested_evidence_template.xlsx) that mirrors what the SIG/SOC2 team expects for quick ingestion. We can accept redacted versions where PII is included; please confirm the redaction approach.

Let me know if the 6-sample size is feasible or if you want to propose a reduced sample (we typically ask for 5–8). If you need an extra 48 hours beyond the 28th, flag it now.

Best,
Elena
Elena Park
Senior SOC2 Auditor
Brightfield Audit

Attachments: requested_evidence_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <epark@brightfield-audit.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding & offboarding controls: evidence snapshot and logistics

Elena — thanks, noted and we can get this started. Attaching an initial snapshot (onboarding_snapshot_v1.csv) that contains our canonical role mapping and a trimmed training export.

A couple of clarifying points before we pull full exports: 
- Are hashed employee IDs acceptable for the training export (we can use SHA256 with a per-batch salt)?
- For background check "confirmations": do you need the original vendor result PDFs or a signed confirmation letter from HR stating checks completed?
- For the offboard samples, we can provide 6 events across engineering, sales, and product. Will that distribution work for SIG ingestion?

If acceptable, Neha will pull redacted vendor confirmations and I will export Okta deprovision events for the sample set. We're also linking the internal evidence folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3OnboardingEvidence — I'll place the exports there.

If you'd rather have fewer samples to start, we can do 3 samples immediately and stage the rest. Please confirm by EOD so we can triage.

Thanks,

—Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: onboarding_snapshot_v1.csv (CSV: role mapping + small training extract)

Marissa / Elena — I can take point on the background check confirmations. A few notes: 

- Our vendor is CheckRight (contracted 2024). They provide verification letters; we will request signed/redacted letters for the sample hires.
- For PII redaction we will remove DOB and SSN fragments and replace employee names with the hashed IDs Marissa mentioned. We can include the vendor reference number in case you need to trace.
- ETA: I can deliver the 6 redacted vendor confirmations + a vendor statement by Monday 26 Jul EOD. If you want the HR attestation instead, I can produce that sooner (by Fri 23 Jul).

I'll drop the checkright_bg_export_redacted.pdf into the evidence folder once I have approvals from CheckRight.

Quick security note: 

We can provide an Okta deprovision events sample (okta_deprov_log_sample.csv) that includes: account_id (hashed), deprov_timestamp, services_revoked (text), initiator (system/manager), and ticket_id. We will redact IP addresses and remove any session tokens. For training exports, we will include completion timestamps and module IDs only, no auth tokens.

If Brightfield needs additional telemetry (last-login, MFA status at time of deprov), we can provide those columns but will need a short justification to avoid sharing unnecessary PII. We are happy to provide a pseudonymization example for your ingest pipeline.

I'll prep the Okta sample and add it to the Drive folder; Neha please proceed with the CheckRight redactions per the HR plan.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Security Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: okta_deprov_log_sample.csv (CSV: 6 sample events, redacted)
